thread:
sam: Rolling out nf4-int4 to web-search + chat interleaved cohorts, starting 5% each route. watching slices: long_queries, non-english, low_token_prefix

jess: heads up — I'll ramp to 15% if smoke looks ok. :eyes:

ml-eval-bot: Smoke report: latency p95 +12ms vs baseline, ROUGE-L -1.1% on long_queries slice, no new hallucinations detected.

rui: That p95 bump is concerning for chat low-latency SLO. what's the fallback threshold we agreed?

sam: Config snippet I'm using for auto-fallback (draft):
```json
{"auto_fallback": {"latency_p95_ms_delta": 10, "metric_drop_pct": 1.5, "window_secs": 900, "min_requests": 1000}}
```

hana: @sam can we make the latency check an absolute threshold instead of just delta? some regions already sit high.

ethan: Proposed hybrid rule: trigger when (delta > 10ms AND abs_p95 > 180ms) OR quality_drop_pct > 1.5 on any watched slice. require 3 consecutive windows to avoid noise.

jess: also add entropy-drift check for token-prefix mismatch — saw small KL spike in long_queries during last run. :thinking_face:

ml-eval-bot: Added KL drift monitor: KL_delta > 0.02 on slice => alert-only for now (no auto-fallback).

rui: If auto-fallback fires, do we revert to previous quant level (nf8) or to fp16 base? need clear policy.

sam: Plan: fallback to last stable pinned tag (model:v2026-02-12-stable) which is fp16. then open ML oncall incident. auto-rollback cooldown = 2h.

jess: :thumbsup: can we also trigger a quiet-burn shadow after fallback? run 1% shadow for 24h to validate before re-promoting.

hana: I'll update the rollout policy in the console and add per-slice dashboards (p50/p95, KL, ROUGE-L).

deploy-bot: deploy pipeline: canary started for cohorts (web-search, chat) at 5%. job=8742.

sam: watching the dashboards now, will post if we need to escalate or revert.
